description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and a metric labeled BPC. The x-axis, labeled “Training Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50,000 with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “BPC,” is a linear scale ranging from 1.2 to 2.2 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A single magenta line, marked with circular data points, represents “SimSMoE Validating.” This line begins at approximately 1.7 at a training step of 0 and declines to approximately 1.25 at a training step of 10,000. Between 10,000 and 20,000 training steps, the line decreases from 1.25 to approximately 1.18. From 20,000 to 50,000 training steps, the line fluctuates between approximately 1.17 and 1.22, ending at approximately 1.19 at a training step of 50,000.
